description: This is a Java source file defining a logging utility class called 'Log' that provides static methods for logging messages at various levels (VERBOSE, DEBUG, INFO, WARN, ERROR, ASSERT). It acts as a helper for managing a chain of LogNode objects to handle log messages, providing a customizable logging mechanism similar to Android's Log class.

classes.name: Log
classes.description: A helper class that provides static methods for logging messages at various levels and managing a chain of LogNode objects.

methods.name: getLogNode
methods.description: Returns the current LogNode in the linked list (or chain).

methods.name: setLogNode
methods.description: Sets the LogNode data will be sent to, establishing the start of the log chain.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Sends a log message with specified priority, tag, message, and optional Throwable to the LogNode chain.

methods.name: v
methods.description: Logs a message at VERBOSE priority level with optional Throwable.

methods.name: d
methods.description: Logs a message at DEBUG priority level with optional Throwable.

methods.name: i
methods.description: Logs a message at INFO priority level with optional Throwable.

methods.name: w
methods.description: Logs a message at WARN priority level, with overloads for accompanying Throwable.

methods.name: e
methods.description: Logs a message at ERROR priority level with optional Throwable.

methods.name: wtf
methods.description: Logs a message at ASSERT priority level, with overloads for accompanying Throwable.
